paragraphs: The RD-33 powers one of the best known Soviet fighters, and a bare engine of this class is among the most demanding aerospace subjects there is: fan face, compressor stages, accessory gearbox, external plumbing and a variable nozzle at the back, all visible because nothing is hidden inside a nacelle.

The mesh is heavy at 1,887,163 polygons and 964,036 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and ships with 6 texture maps at 4096x4096. The polygon count sitting well above the vertex count is what happens on machinery built from many small separate parts.
At $199 it suits aerospace marketing and engineering presentation, aviation maintenance and training material, museum and trade show displays, documentary work and games. On sale since 2016.
